title: Community weights ingestion bridge with signed manifests, conversion/quant validation, and profile publish
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build an end-to-end, auditable ingestion bridge for community-contributed model weights that enforces signed manifests, performs deterministic format conversion and quantization validation, runs runtime profiling, and publishes a canonical pinned version + performance profile to the model catalog. This ticket covers the orchestrator glue and validation rules (admission -> conversion -> smoke -> profile -> publish) and the required telemetry/events for rollback and auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Inbound weights with signed manifest can be accepted/declined by the admission service with deterministic reasons recorded
Automated conversion pipeline produces repeatable runtime-compatible artifacts (onnx/ggml/torchscript) with checksumable outputs
Quantization/precision validation suite runs and fails fast on mismatches or accuracy regressions beyond configurable thresholds
Profiling job runs end-to-end (latency P50/P95, memory, KV-cache behavior) and publishes a structured performance profile to the model catalog UI
Pin creation API call publishes canonical version + associated performance profile and mark isImmutable=true
Audit trail and telemetry make it possible to trace from original upload -> PR -> published pin -> serving variant
End-to-end e2e smoke test that pulls pin and runs a small inference workload in staging must pass in < 5 minutes
steps: Admission: verify signed manifest, virus scan, provenance metadata (model name, authors, license)
Staging ingest: store original weights in cold S3 with checksum and immutable storage class
Conversion: run deterministic conversion pipeline (hf->torchscript/onnx/ggml) inside hermetic container; produce artifact bundle with metadata
Quant/Accuracy: run specified calibration/eval suite on canonical eval sets; compute token-level and end-task metrics
Profiling: schedule runtime microbench for target hardware profiles (a100, t4, cpu-quant) to collect latency/memory/batching behavior
Validation gating: apply rule engine (accuracy delta, latencies, memory) and surface human review if thresholds exceeded
Pin & Publish: create a pin in catalog with artifact manifest, profile JSON, and optional canary rollout policy
Post-publish: emit audit events, create GH PR with release notes and publish dashboard snapshot
